viewing: Numeric only. CT intensities were read along rays into arrays; no image was written, displayed or viewed.

geometry.centre: official umbilicus 20260411134726-umbilicus-20260524235033.json, linear in z, mapped to 1.129 um with the volume transform.json (landmark residual 0.2-1.9 vox at 2.4 um)
geometry.labelled_crossings: 20260623141924-w010-027 2.4 um mesh mapped to 1.129 um; per-z polyline (one point per mesh column), crossings of 64 rays labelled by unwrapped angle; column 0 is the outer end (w027) and labels are re-keyed so 0 = w010
geometry.sampling: bilinear, 1 vox (1.129 um) steps from r=0 to the w020 crossing + 68 um; one full-resolution z-plane per level read by byte ranges from the uncompressed zarr chunks

detector.peaks: scipy find_peaks, min distance 20 um, prominence threshold chosen from the grid [2,3,4,6,8,12,16] grey levels by the fixed rule: median count in the labelled zone (w011..w020, 10 windings) closest to 10
detector.inner_zone: r < r(w010) - half the local w010-w011 spacing

run_history: Run 1 (17:4x-18:3xZ) labelled crossings from mesh column 0 as w010; the mesh column 0 is w027. It was stopped at level 10 of 24 before any inner count was computed and is not used. Run 2 (this) started ~18:36Z with radius-based orientation; its labels were checked monotone in radius before launch.
